newsitem.title: USA: Salomon Brothers Oct same-store sales index up.
newsitem.headline: Salomon Brothers Oct same-store sales index up.

text.p: Salomon Brothers said Thursday its same-store sales growth index for retailers rose 4.8 percent in October versus a 0.4 percent gain a year ago and a 3.7 percent rise in September.
"October sales were positively impacted by an improving environment for apparel, more seasonal weather and relatively easy comparisons," Salomon Brothers analysts said in a research report.

Among those benefiting from strong apparel sales was Sears, Roebuck and Co, which reported a 5.3 percent gain in October same-store sales. Kmart Corp reported better softlines business, while its overall comparable-store sales were up 1.3 percent. Dayton Hudson Corp reported comparable-store sales up 6.0 percent.

Other analysts said consumer electronics sales continued to be weak. Best Buy Co Inc said same-store sales fell 15 percent in October and forecast a negative comparison for November. Circuit City Stores Inc said comparable-store sales fell nine percent last month.

Sears shares were up 1/2 to 48-1/8. Kmart was unchanged at 9-3/4, Dayton Hudson was up 7/8 at 35-3/4, Gap Inc was up 1-1/8 at 31-1/4, Federated Department Stores Inc was unchanged at 33-3/8, and Wal-Mart Stores Inc was unchanged at 26-7/8.
Best Buy was down 2-7/8 at 13-3/8 and Circuit City was up 3/8 at 34-7/8.
